Mixed-Signal ASIC Design Lab, Inha University

AMPLIA

We design precision analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits — from sensor read-out front-ends and high-resolution data converters to circuits for processing-in-memory.

    Research Interests

    Precision IC design based on analog and mixed-signal for various sensors, wearable devices, intelligent robots,
    smart factories, measurement devices, IoT, AI, security and automotive applications    .

    • R/01

      Analog and Mixed-Signal Circuits

      AMS · CMOS

    • R/02

      Sensor Read-Out ICs

      ROIC · AFE

    • R/03

      Ultra-High-Precision ICs

      20b+ · LOW-NOISE

    • R/04

      Instrumentation Amplifiers

      IA · CHOPPER · PGA

    • R/05

      Sub-Miniature ICs

      AREA-EFFICIENT

    • R/06

      Low-Power Analog Circuits

      µW · ENERGY-EFFICIENT

    • R/07

      Analog-to-Digital Converters

      INCREMENTAL · ΔΣ · SAR · SINGLE-SLOPE

    • R/08

      Array Circuitry for IoT/AI

      COLUMN-PARALLEL · ARRAY

    • R/09

      Power Management ICs

      LDO · REGULATOR

    • R/10

      Neuron Circuit for Neuromorphic Computing

      PiM · NEUROMORPHIC
